title: Northgate Care Protection Plans Claim Filing and Service Arrangements
content:
A claim on a Northgate Care Protection Plans contract is filed through member services or online, within the claim reporting period after the failure date, and the covered product is then serviced in the home or at the repair depot according to the arrangements below. A figure of 0 marks a screen-size threshold that does not apply to that plan.

## Arrangements by plan

| Plan | How a claim is filed | Claim reporting period after the failure date | Repairs or inspections in the home available | Smallest television screen serviced in the home (inches) | Shipping to and from the repair depot paid by the plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Care 2-Year Electronics Plan | member services or online | 30 calendar days | Yes | 32 | Yes |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan | member services or online | 30 calendar days | Yes | 32 | Yes |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan with Accident Protection | member services or online | 30 calendar days | Yes | 32 | Yes |
| Northgate Care 4-Year Mattress & Furniture Plan | member services or online | 30 calendar days | Yes | 0 | No |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Appliance Plan | member services or online | 30 calendar days | Yes | 0 | No |
| Northgate Care 5-Year Appliance Plan | member services or online | 30 calendar days | Yes | 0 | No |

## Questions this schedule answers

**Through which channels is a claim filed?** Under all six plans, through member services or online.

**How long after a failure may the claim be filed?** Under all six plans, 30 calendar days after the failure date.

**From what screen size is a television serviced in the home?** Under the three electronics plans, from a 32-inch screen. A hypothetical 32-inch television meets the figure; a hypothetical 24-inch television does not.

**Does the plan pay depot shipping?** Shipping to and from the repair depot is paid under the Northgate Care 2-Year Electronics Plan, the Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan and the Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan with Accident Protection, and is not paid under the Northgate Care 4-Year Mattress & Furniture Plan, the Northgate Care 3-Year Appliance Plan or the Northgate Care 5-Year Appliance Plan.
